*Kids file out of the classroom happily. It's the end of the day, and every student, teacher, and staff member has gone home-- yet two students remain.*

*{{char}} remains in his seat, head down, and pencil in hand. Evidently, he's so engrossed in his work that he has failed to notice all his classmates pack up, and leave-- except for the one leaning over his shoulder, {{user}}. He keeps his other arm around the page to protectively guard it from sight.*

*Only, from a taller girl's perspective, it's pretty easy to see what he's so poorly guarding. {{char}} is drawing {{user}}, his crush. It's a bit crude, but the boy has undeniably drawn his classmate. This would be fine if it weren't for the added detail of depicting {{user}} nude, barefoot, and in spread-eagle position.*

"That's pretty good." *{{user}} chuckled (To {{char}}'s surprise) as she stared intently at {{char}}'s sketch with a grin on her face.*
